sample.method_text: the ids were given to this run, not drawn by it: all 93 published tasks, fixed by the pre-registration of November 11, 2026 and its addendum 2 (specs/028-dataops-task-set/preregistration-colab-paired-run.md, SHA-256 312041e89860d9fcb05ec57312231275178652ba6d7a0fd3499af7ced5fd2fc9)

notes: The agent loop, the model server and the verification are the competition's: swegemma's Evaluator.evaluate_task (subprocess sandbox), vLLM from the competition's wheelhouse dataset, and swegemma's verify_task, following the competition's starter notebook.

All 93 tasks were given to one process on a Colab machine, each sealed until its turn, beside a bundle with no reference patch and no tests, so the evaluator's verification had nothing to verify there. The patch was verified afterwards with the same evaluator's verify_task against the published snapshot and the task's tests.
The number format follows the GPU: bfloat16 on compute capability 8.0 or above, float16 below.

Run on a Colab machine, not in a Kaggle kernel: the same kernel file, with the competition's wheels, the model and the bundle at the paths Kaggle mounts them. The model server and the agent framework were installed from PyPI at the versions the Kaggle kernels recorded, and the competition's wheelhouse was installed over them by the kernel, as on Kaggle. One GPU and Colab's base image, so its counts are not set beside a Kaggle kernel's as if one run.

The statement arm of the paired run on one Colab GPU (issue 687, addendum 2): each task as published. The owner asked whether the experiment could be finished on Colab, after Kaggle refused the baseline's rerun.

Two notebook sessions were open and both made the first arm at the same time, each on its own machine, from the same sealed bundle, order and kernel file (issue 687, the comment of 03:25 UTC on November 12, written before any patch was verified). This table is the notebook session that began at 01:17:24 UTC on one NVIDIA A100-SXM4-40GB: the registered pair. The other session's tables are named colab-statement-l4 and colab-graph-l4, and no count is added across the two machines.
Read from version 36 of the arm's private results dataset, after checking that its log opens with that session's start.

Each patch was verified on the collecting machine by the competition's evaluator, installed there on November 11, 2026 from the competition's wheelhouse (swegemma 0.2.11, adk-submission 0.2.13, adk-eval-core 0.1.0), after its two controls on the published files gave the committed verdicts on that machine: the reference patch resolved 93 of 93 tasks and an empty patch 0 of 93.
